request:
Which functions or methods in the click library (src/click/) directly call both the style function from src/click/termui.py and the echo function from src/click/utils.py? Give the symbol ID.

Requested output columns: symbol_id (string).
explanation: The query finds all public functions/methods in the click package that contain at least one call to the 'style' function from termui.py and at least one call to the 'echo' function from utils.py. It joins symbols with call edges to both target functions, filters by package and module paths, and returns distinct symbol IDs.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.symbol_id
FROM code.symbols s
JOIN code.calls c1 ON s.symbol_id = c1.caller_symbol_id
JOIN code.calls c2 ON s.symbol_id = c2.caller_symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols t1 ON c1.callee_symbol_id = t1.symbol_id
JOIN code.symbols t2 ON c2.callee_symbol_id = t2.symbol_id
JOIN code.files f1 ON s.file_id = f1.file_id
JOIN code.files f2 ON t1.file_id = f2.file_id
JOIN code.files f3 ON t2.file_id = f3.file_id
WHERE f1.package = 'click'
  AND f1.module LIKE '%termui'
  AND t1.name = 'style'
  AND f2.package = 'click'
  AND f2.module LIKE '%utils'
  AND t2.name = 'echo'
  AND s.kind IN ('function', 'method')
  AND s.is_public = TRUE;
